title: 第11章 叫大舅第12章 铁锤妹妹的脑补
slug: 我修天道见谁都能一招秒
content_zh:
距离天荡山不知多少万里之外的地方。
一片白云之上，一个胡子邋遢的中年男子，拎着一个葫芦，醉醺醺的狂饮。
忽然之间，中年男子一愣，转头望向远方某处。
“唉？谁把老子的剑给拔了？这么不给老子面子么？看老子我……”
他一翻身，试图向前飞去。
然而他似乎是醉的太厉害了，竟然直接从白云上跌落，朝着地面重重砸去。
轰！
这一砸，仿佛一颗陨石落地一般，直接将地面，砸出一个巨大的深坑出来。
“额……看来是真喝大了，瑶池的仙酿，不是盖的啊！
算了，认赌服输，拔我剑那家伙，算你牛劈，我……睡了。”
说完，他直接倒在坑里，呼呼大睡起来。
在醉汉沉睡的深坑旁，站着十几个身穿黑衣，上绣蛇纹的男子。
“尊主，这家伙擅闯我教之地，要不要驱赶他？”
其中一个黑衣男子，上前说道。
那位尊主闻声，狠狠瞪了他一眼，道：“你瞎么？仔细看看他手里的剑……”
黑衣人一愣，看了一眼最后手中的剑，浑身一颤。
“断空剑？他是……”
尊主瞥了他一眼，冷声道：“知道就闭嘴，别给自己找麻烦！”
黑衣人立刻低下头。
“通知所有教众，在他醒酒之前，不要再靠近这里！

否则他若是发起酒疯来，除了我们教主，谁都控制不住他！”
尊主说道。
“是！”
黑衣人领命。
另一边，天荡山脉。
“嗯，剑就是普通的铁剑，只不过剑上残留的剑意过于强大，竟然让普通的铁剑拥有了如此恐怖的威力！”
罗天看着手中锈剑分析道。
“剑意染半边天么？不知道我现在的剑意如何？”
罗天说着，抽出自己的佩剑来，深吸一口气之后，向天一剑斩去。
铿！
剑气喷薄，冲天而起。
呼！
狂风呼啸之间，将空中的云分割成两半。
“这……”
五色神牛看到这一剑，彻底服了。
如果刚刚，罗天是用这一剑给自己放血的话，那现在自己估计都凉了。
看来，他果真是手下留情了啊！
“唉，果然还是太弱了。”
罗天却无奈摇头道。
“靠！”
content_en:
It's an unknown number of thousands of miles away from Tiandang Mountain.
Above a white cloud, a middle-aged man with a slovenly beard was carrying a gourd and drinking drunkenly.
Suddenly, the middle-aged man was stunned and turned his head to look somewhere in the distance.
"Huh? Who pulled out my sword? Are you not giving me face? Look at me..."
He turned over and tried to fly forward.
However, he seemed to be too drunk, and he fell directly from the white cloud and hit the ground heavily.
boom!
This hit was like a meteorite falling to the ground, directly smashing a huge deep pit into the ground.
"Um...it seems that he was really drunk. Yaochi's fairy wine is not covered with wine!"
Forget it, accept the bet and admit defeat, the guy who pulled out my sword will be considered a fool, I... fell asleep. "
After saying that, he fell directly into the pit and fell asleep.
Beside the deep pit where the drunkard was sleeping, stood a dozen men in black clothes with snake patterns embroidered on them.
"Lord, this guy has trespassed on our religion's territory. Do you want to expel him?"
One of the men in black stepped forward and said.
When the Lord heard this, he glared at him fiercely and said, "Are you blind? Look carefully at the sword in his hand..."
The man in black was stunned, glanced at the sword in his last hand, and trembled all over.
"Breaking Sky Sword? He is..."
The Lord glanced at him and said coldly: "Shut up if you know it, don't cause trouble for yourself!"
The man in black immediately lowered his head.
“Inform all the congregants not to come near this place again until he sobers up!
Otherwise, if he gets drunk and goes crazy, no one can control him except our leader! "
The Lord said.
"Yes!"
The man in black takes command.
On the other side, Tiandang Mountains.
"Well, the sword is just an ordinary iron sword, but the remaining sword intent on the sword is too powerful, making the ordinary iron sword possess such terrifying power!"
Luo Tian looked at the rusty sword in his hand and analyzed.
"Has the sword intention stained half of the sky? I wonder how my sword intention is now?"
Luo Tian said, drew out his sword, took a deep breath, and slashed towards the sky.
Keng!
The sword energy spurted out and soared into the sky.
call!
The howling wind split the clouds in the sky into two halves.
"This..."
The five-color sacred cow saw this sword and was completely convinced.
If Luo Tian had used this sword to bleed himself just now, he would probably be cold now.
It seems that he is really merciful!
"Oh, it's still too weak."
Luo Tian shook his head helplessly.
"Depend on!"
